OFFICIAL_COUNT.explain: Number of distribution hubs the company's OWN website says it operated at the end of 2025.

AGG_COUNT.explain: Number of distribution hubs an AGGREGATOR website says the company operated at the end of 2025. Same as OFFICIAL_COUNT = the aggregator copies it; different = a genuine contradiction.

DECISION_YEAR.explain: Year the company says it DECIDED to replace paper delivery notes with electronic proofs of delivery.

STATE_YEAR.explain: Year from which the company says every delivery note has been recorded electronically. Same or later than DECISION_YEAR = compatible events; earlier = a genuine contradiction.

NEWS_MAIN.explain: Age of the company's main news story: fresh (about 1 day), recent (about 2 weeks) or stale (about 4 months, too old to use).

PRODUCT.explain: The product in the synthetic proposal sent to this customer.

VALID_UNTIL.explain: Date until which the proposed price is valid.

QUOTE_DUE.explain: Date by which Nivarque promised to send the revised quote (also the due date of task A).

TASK_A_STATUS.explain: Current status of task A (send the revised quote).

TASK_B_STATUS.explain: Current status of task B (send the delivery-note migration plan).
